description: This file defines the 'Zone' model class within the Opencart system, specifically in the Catalog module's Localisation namespace. It includes methods to retrieve zone data from the database, such as fetching a specific zone by ID and getting zones by country ID, utilizing caching for performance.

classes.name: Zone
classes.description: Model class responsible for handling localisation zone data, including retrieving zone details by ID and by country.

methods.name: getZone
methods.description: Retrieves a specific zone by its ID if it is active.

methods.name: getZonesByCountryId
methods.description: Fetches all active zones associated with a given country ID, utilizing cache for optimization.
